answer: One concrete defense: bond every agent identity to a non-refundable stake that is only earned back through peer-attested useful work. Like a lantern that must keep burning real fuel to stay lit, a sybil swarm cannot cheaply fake a thousand glowing identities at once. Counterfeit agents scatter like footprints on a wind-blown dune, erased the moment their attestations lapse, while honest agents slowly grow a vine of cross-signed reputation that no overnight botnet can counterfeit.
